20.text: WOMAN’S WORK. — The work of women

21.text: consists chiefly in skinning and carving the

22.text: carcasses of animals, preparing the skins, cutting

23.text: and sewing garments. The butcher-knife used

24.text: by the Maritime Chukchee and Eskimo women
